source_title: Alexa Chung Flashes Her ‘Haunted’ Ring After Confirming Engagement to Tom Sturridge - People.com
source_excerpt:
The model and the actor have been romantically linked since 2022
Alexa Chung confirmed her engagement to Tom Sturridge on Oct. 23
The model flashed her “haunted” engagement ring on Instagram on Oct. 28
Her vintage ring is from the Tudor period
Alexa Chung is giving fans a glimpse of her sparkly and spooky engagement ring.
The British model, 42, confirmed her engagement to fiancé Tom Sturridge , 40, in an interview with More or Less published on Friday, Oct. 23. At the time, she revealed that the actor proposed with a vintage ring that may or may not be haunted.
Five days lateron Wednesday, Oct. 28, Chung flashed her engagement ring in a selfie posted on Instagram .
“Ummm here are some relatively similar looking sideways photos of me wearing grey,” she captioned her carousel, which featured four casual selfies of her at home and in a subway station.
Chung shared the haunting history of her engagement ring with More or Less , explaining that she has a Tudor ring, which refers to any style of ring crafted or inspired by the fashion of England and Wales during the Tudor period, which spanned from 1485 to 1603.
“Tom knows how much I adore vintage and antiques, and he got me a beautiful Tudor ring,” she said. “It’s like a table-cut diamond.”
The bride-to-be said that she had seen similar ring designs in portraits at the National Portrait Gallery, including those of Anne Boleyn and several other people who “perished” at the hands of King Henry VIII .
“When I went to get my hair done in Paris, my lovely friend Alexandri, who was doing my hair getting ready for a fashion show, said, ‘Oh my god, I think your ring is haunted,’ ” she recalled to More or Less . “And he took it off my finger and started making wishes around it and blowing on it.”
“So, I hope that my ring isn’t haunted. Or do I? Because that’s iconic,” she added.

Chung and Sturridge have been romantically linked for more than four years and have largely kept their romance out of the spotlight.
The two confirmed their relationship in July 2022 when they shared a public kiss at Wimbledon . In May 2023, they made their red carpet debut as a couple at the 2023 Met Gala . The following month, they sparked engagement rumors after Chung was seen wearing a gold ring on that finger while strolling with the actor in London’s Notting Hill.
Sturridge shares a daughter, Marlowe , 14, with ex Sienna Miller .
